showHistory.title: For Our Families
showHistory.body: Father, thank You for the families You have placed in our lives, both near and far. Where there is distance, bring connection. Where there is tension, bring patience and honest words spoken with love. Bless every home represented here today. Amen.

showHistory.title: Counting Gifts
showHistory.body: Lord, we stop to name what is good in this day, even if it is only one thing. Thank You for kindness shown to us and for the chance to show kindness to someone else. Amen.

showHistory.title: When the Body Is Weak
